chapter: Decca records, the Savoy and Moe Gale
title: Gale demands repayment and Tomino heads for Chicago
summary: The Gale office said it needed its money back or a share of the band, and Tomino left for Chicago while McShann was kept in New York.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: I said, yeh, so they said, now, here's what we're going to have to do, we're going to have to get our money back that we put out on you and they had it right to the __now, we sent your money here and sent you there, money there and so on, says now we've got to get our money back. So now either that or we're going to have to take over a certain percentage of the band and everything, you know what I mean.
So in the meantime to me, though, he was with us --
Well, Tomino didn't travel with you, did he?
Yes, he was traveling with us then.

Yes. So Tomino had realized what they was doing, you know what I mean, so after he realized what they were doing, he told me, well, I'm going to Chicago now, because they intend to annihilate us. We're going to get annihilated here, but they wanted --

Well, yes, see we had to get Tomino out of there and then -- see, I'm the one that owe them the money. In other words, he's got to go and then for me to pay them back, you know what I mean, because they were selling Jay McShann.
Got to give them a piece.

Got to give them a piece of it so I talked with them down there that day, and I said, well, look, man, we've been around a shorter period, when these dates came along, I don't know what we're going to do. Don't worry about a thing, you can get all the money you need, you can get anything you need here.
